title: Coverslips Preparation for seqFISH
author: Nina Dar
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.7mihk4e
materials: Preparation of PLL (or PDL*) coated slides:
Sharp diamond pen to cut glass

steps.title: Prepare silanization solution
steps.instruction: Mix 180 mL of 100 % ethanol, 2 mL of 1 M acetic acid, 16 mL of RNase‑free water, and 2 mL of bind‑silane in a clean container.

steps.title: Trim coverslip corner
steps.instruction: Cut the left‑upper corner of each coverslip; this will be the side that later receives the coating.

steps.title: Ethanol wash and dry
steps.instruction: Place the coverslips in a slide holder, add enough 100 % ethanol to completely cover them, then remove the excess ethanol and dry the coverslips in an oven for 5–10 min.

substeps.instruction: Remove the plastic cover from the plasma oven and place the coverslips on the exposed surface.
Close the black lid, ensure the air valve is closed, and hold the lid firmly until a vacuum is created.
When the micron indicator reads 400, turn the valve 90° clockwise to allow a small air flow that initiates plasma formation.
When the micron indicator reaches 900, set the RF level to ‘high’ and run the plasma for 5 min.
After the 5‑min timer expires, hold the lid firmly, turn the RF level ‘OFF’, turn the pump ‘OFF’, and switch Power ‘OFF’.
Turn the valve very slowly 180° counter‑clockwise to re‑introduce air.
Remove the lid and gently take the coverslips out.

steps.title: Silane coat coverslips
steps.instruction: Place the plasma‑treated coverslips (functional side up) in a petri dish or on parafilm, add the bind‑silane solution prepared in Step 1, and incubate for 1 h at room temperature.

steps.title: Rinse and heat‑cure
steps.instruction: Discard the bind‑silane solution, rinse the coverslips three times with 100 % ethanol, then heat‑cure them in an oven at 90 °C for 30 min.

steps.title: Apply PDL coating
steps.instruction: Lay the coverslips flat (functionalized side up) on parafilm or in petri dishes, cover each with approximately 1 mL of PDL/PBS solution ensuring full coverage of the area where samples will be placed.

steps.title: Incubate PDL
steps.instruction: Incubate the PDL‑covered coverslips for at least 3 h, preferably overnight, at room temperature.

steps.title: Wash and air‑dry
steps.instruction: Remove the PDL solution, wash the coverslips with RNase‑free water, and allow them to air‑dry completely.

steps.title: Mount coverslips on slides
steps.instruction: Place a drop of ethanol on a glass slide, then position the coverslip (coated side up) onto the ethanol drop, ensuring the tissue‑attachment side faces upward.

steps.title: Store prepared coverslips
steps.instruction: Store the assembled coverslip‑slide units at –20 °C and use them within one week.

steps.title: Slice tissue for seqFISH
steps.instruction: After the coverslips are ready, slice the tissue to the desired thickness (typically 10–100 µm) for downstream seqFISH processing.
